about: Marches on an enemy castle or town, waits near it for the named lords if you give any, then besieges it. The game assaults once the siege engines are ready.
calls_back: enemy lords and armies near it or heading for it, counted together, are strong enough to matter (and again each time they grow by half its strength), the siege is won, or it is broken

wait_hours: how long to wait near it for the named lords
relief_ratio: call back when the enemy lords and armies within relief_radius of it or heading for it from anywhere, all counted together, reach this many times its strength
relief_radius: how near counts for that, in map units (those seen heading for it count wherever they are)

when.poke: {at} is no longer an enemy holding.
{at} is no longer an enemy holding.
{me} waited {wait_hours} hours near {at}; {lords_arrived()} of {lords_count()} lords came. Besieging now.
{at} is no longer an enemy holding.

when.if: hours_in_state > 6 and not besieging and not within(at, 3)
relief_coming(at, relief_radius) >= pick(relief_told > 0, relief_told + strength * 0.5, strength * relief_ratio)
when.poke: A relief is coming to {at}: {relief_count(at, relief_radius)} enemy lords and armies within {relief_radius} of it or heading for it, strength {relief_coming(at, relief_radius)} together, against {me}'s {strength}. Nearest first: {relief_of(at, relief_radius)}.
